title: Adams' Synchronological Chart, a zoomable timeline
summary: Sebastian Adams's 23-foot wall chart of world history, from Creation to the 1870s, can now be explored up close: zoom from the whole sweep of the ages down to a single picture, and tap any of 1,138 marked pictures, events and people to see the year the chart gives and the books and topics that tell its story. It lives on the new Resources page, beside the Topics.

items.text: New timeline: Adams' Synchronological Chart of Universal History, with 1,138 marked pictures, events and people linked to the books and topics.
A new Resources page gathers the Topics and the Timelines in one place.
The study notes in every book now call the site's translation by its full name, the Plain English Translation.
